Some experts also highlighted the ambiguous effect of Nvidia's large S&P 500 index weight, since it makes the outperformance hurdle both higher and more self-referential.

In summary, experts agree that Nvidia's fundamentals, momentum, and market narrative make outperformance more probable than for a typical S&P 500 constituent, yet the risk of a sharp correction or mean reversion—especially given sky-high expectations—prevents an extremely high probability estimate. Most forecasters peg the likelihood in the mid-to high-60s, reflecting both the exceptional, though fragile, status of Nvidia and its sector in the current market environment.
